root_cause.text: The Mediatek MDP probe path in `drivers/media/platform/mediatek/mdp/mtk_mdp_core.c` failed to correctly handle errors after acquiring the VPU platform device and registering the M2M device, so a NULL `vpu_get_plat_device()` result could be dereferenced and the acquired device/resource references were leaked on probe failure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (!mdp->vpu_dev) { ... goto err_vpu_get_dev; }` before using `mdp->vpu_dev` in `vpu_wdt_reg_handler()`, adds `platform_device_put(mdp->vpu_dev);` on later failures because `vpu_get_plat_device()` increments the refcount, and adds `mtk_mdp_unregister_m2m_device(mdp);` in the error path to clean up the M2M device that was previously left registered.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a null check for the VPU device during probe and fix the error handling path for reset-handler registration failure.
intent_record.what: The probe function now checks whether `vpu_get_plat_device(pdev)` returned a valid device pointer before using it, logs an error and returns `-ENODEV` if it is null, and changes the error path for `vpu_wdt_reg_handler()` failure from `err_m2m_register` to a new `err_reg_handler` label.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the driver will fail probe early instead of dereferencing or registering against a missing VPU device, preventing invalid access and providing a clearer error when the VPU platform device is unavailable. The revised goto target also routes reset-handler registration failures to a more appropriate cleanup path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix probe error handling to jump to the correct cleanup label when vb2 DMA segment size setup fails.
intent_record.what: In mtk_mdp_probe(), the error path taken when vb2_dma_contig_set_max_seg_size() fails was changed from goto err_m2m_register; to goto err_reg_handler;.
intent_record.how: If setting the vb2 DMA contiguous max segment size fails during probe, execution now jumps to the err_reg_handler cleanup label instead of the m2m registration cleanup label, which changes the teardown path to match the point of failure and avoids invoking the wrong cleanup sequence.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing probe error cleanup for VPU and M2M resources in `mtk_mdp_probe()`.
intent_record.what: Two new error-handling labels were added in `mtk_mdp_probe()`: `err_reg_handler:` calls `platform_device_put(mdp->vpu_dev);`, and `err_vpu_get_dev:` calls `mtk_mdp_unregister_m2m_device(mdp);`. These labels are placed before the existing `err_m2m_register:` cleanup path.
intent_record.how: This extends the probe failure cleanup sequence so that if later initialization steps fail after acquiring/registering the VPU device or M2M device, the driver now releases the VPU platform device reference and unregisters the M2M device before continuing to the remaining cleanup. It prevents resource leaks and inconsistent partial initialization on probe failure.

candidates.rationale: This uses mdp->vpu_dev immediately after vpu_get_plat_device(pdev) with no NULL check, so a NULL return from vpu_get_plat_device() can be dereferenced during probe.
This acquires the VPU platform device without any subsequent validation in the pre-fix flow, enabling later dereference of a NULL device pointer.
On reset-handler registration failure, execution jumps to the M2M cleanup path only, which does not account for all acquired probe resources and contributes to leaked references on failure.
This cleanup path is insufficient by itself for earlier probe failures involving the VPU device and M2M registration, reflecting the missing error cleanup that caused leaked resources.
